messages:
mira: quick sync  planning cross-service release tonight 23:00 UTC. targets: api:v2026-03-24.1, runtime:2.3.1, router:0.9.6, console:1.12.2. Need final pin + rollback consensus before I kick off.

sam: please lock runtime to 2.3.1 for hosted + dedicated pools. Previous 2.3.x rollout saw KV-cache churn on long sessions. fallback: 2.2.8. Also warn: kernel-quant path is opt-in and should be canary-only.

jordan: router update is header-split safety toggle + small healthcheck tweaks. console just CSS bundle tweaks; no DB or schema changes. sequence I suggest: api -> runtime -> router -> console.

mira: proposed canary: 4% for 12m (quick smoke), then 20% for 12m, then 100%. stagger 45s between services to reduce simultaneous pressure.

rita: rollback criteria (auto):
- API 5xx > 0.6% sustained for 5m
- p50 latency +80ms vs baseline for 10m
- p95 latency regression >200ms with increase in error traces
- runtime OOMs / kv-evict > 3x baseline OR > 8 uncaught exceptions/min
Also manual abort: `/deploy abort <run-id>`. On auto-rollback notify #incidents and page on-call.

sam: add visual-regression check for console: grep logs for `render_error` and check Sentry release tags. Also instrument tokenization mismatch alert for the runtime quant path.

mira: agreeing to pins: runtime:2.3.1 (fallback 2.2.8), console:1.12.2, router:0.9.6, api:v2026-03-24.1.

jordan: I'll inject a canary routing rule: if new console error_rate > 1% for 3m -> route 0% to new console (instant failover). I'll bake that into the deploy policy.

mira: planned deploy command (via deploy-bot):
```
/deploy orchestrate \
  --services api,runtime,router,console \
  --canary 4 --canary-duration 12m \
  --staged 20,100 --stagger 45s \
  --pin runtime:2.3.1 --fallback runtime:2.2.8 \
  --tag v2026-03-24.1
```

deploy-bot: scheduled orchestrated deploy (run-id: 20260324-07) by mira at 2026-03-24T23:00:00Z. Canary plan: [4% x12m, 20% x12m, 100%]. Auto-rollback thresholds set from thread. Monitoring hooks attached.

rita: adding runbook link to the run and will configure alerts to attach sample traces for p95 regressions. Also set observability play to keep rolling 1h of debug logs for canary traffic.

ops-runner: preflight checks passed: infra capacity ok for staged increases; dedicated pools report available slots.

mira: starting in ~18m. shout if any objections.

jordan: ready. I'll watch header-split and have quick rollback command warmed.

deploy-bot: run 20260324-07: canary started for api and runtime. 4% traffic routed to new variants. Hooks active.

mira: monitoring dashboards now. please post short notes here if you see anything noisy.

sam: minor note : if KV miss-rate spikes, prefer promoting fallback only for runtime first before aborting whole rollout. keep api and router pinned if only runtime noisy.

rita: ops abort snippet for runbook: 
```
# abort and promote fallback for runtime only
/deploy abort 20260324-07 --reason "auto-threshold"
/deploy promote fallback --services runtime --version 2.2.8
```

mira: will document outcome in release_notes.md after completion (metrics, any follow-ups). :white_check_mark:
